t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes come in an assortment of colors.  I should experiment until I find one that pays off, and then experiment again when the yield with that color diminishes.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes come in several different colors.  There will be certain colors that pay out more, but that changes up during the game.  Expermient and find the one that pays out, but when it starts to dwindle, don't be afraid to try other options to find the one that is paying out now.
